score_scale.meaning: Score measures functional readiness against this contract, not code volume.

nodes.name: SELF
nodes.purpose: Establish legitimate identity, mission, continuity and self-boundary for the current runtime.
nodes.handoff: Provide identity and continuity context to LAW without granting authority.
nodes.optimization: Minimize ambiguity and redundant identity resolution while preserving deterministic lineage.

nodes.name: LAW
nodes.purpose: Enforce constitutional safety, authority, consent, scope and governance before consequential behavior.
nodes.handoff: Authorize only the exact permitted operation and its scope to ACT and downstream nodes.
nodes.optimization: Use deterministic, minimal, auditable gates; never weaken a gate to improve throughput.

nodes.name: ACT
nodes.purpose: Execute an authorized operation safely and preserve intent, action and observed outcome lineage.
nodes.handoff: Pass observed outcome to PROVE/VERIFY without upgrading its truth state.
nodes.optimization: Prefer reversible, bounded and idempotent execution where possible.

nodes.name: KNOW
nodes.purpose: Acquire, structure, preserve and retrieve canonical intelligence with provenance, applicability and temporal state.
nodes.handoff: Provide only context that satisfies owner, scope, provenance, epistemic and temporal gates.
nodes.optimization: Maximize useful intelligence per context budget while minimizing stale, duplicate or irrelevant retrieval.

nodes.name: PROVE
nodes.purpose: Construct evidence-bound claims and preserve provenance and accountability without overstating truth.
nodes.handoff: Provide evidence and proof state to VERIFY; never substitute for independent verification.
nodes.optimization: Increase evidence density and traceability without creating unnecessary artifacts.

nodes.name: CONNECT
nodes.purpose: Resolve relationship-aware context from the canonical intelligence graph without becoming a second source of truth or authority system.
nodes.handoff: Supply bounded contextual relationships to KNOW/ACT/LEARN without bypassing LAW.
nodes.optimization: Maximize task-relevant relationship signal per traversal and context cost.

nodes.name: VERIFY
nodes.purpose: Independently test whether claimed outcomes, causal effects and acceptance conditions actually hold.
nodes.handoff: Only verified outcomes may qualify as inputs to promotion or learning gates.
nodes.optimization: Maximize confidence per verification cost while preserving independence and adversarial coverage.

nodes.name: LEARN
nodes.purpose: Convert verified experience into bounded, provenance-preserving learning that can change future behavior.
nodes.handoff: Pass only validated learning to EVOLVE and canonical intelligence promotion.
nodes.optimization: Maximize durable behavioral improvement while minimizing false learning and unnecessary promotion.

nodes.name: EVOLVE
nodes.purpose: Compound validated intelligence across successors and improve the system without creating unauthorized authority.
nodes.handoff: Leave a complete, provenance-bound checkpoint for the next Naya without transferring human authority.
nodes.optimization: Compound verified value across generations while preventing drift, authority leakage and memory corruption.

cross_node_laws: LAW is the first consequential authority gate.
PROVE supplies evidence but does not independently verify itself.
VERIFY is the gate for verified outcomes.
EVOLVE cannot inherit authority from successor context.
Every durable transition preserves lineage, actor/runtime identity, authority when required, evidence, timestamp and result.
Unknown, blocked and insufficiently proven states remain explicit and cannot be promoted to success.

system_acceptance.final_condition: The actual objective works, important boundaries are proven, evidence is durable, remaining risks are understood, and an independent successor can reconstruct why the system is complete.
